title: Complete daily attendance reminder deep-link and robustness

requirements.text: Update the daily attendance reminder notification content to exactly match the required English strings when sent: Title exactly "Attendance Not Marked 📢" and Body exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now.", and keep the reminder deduped to at most once per local calendar day using the existing settings.lastReminderDate mechanism.
acceptanceCriteria: When a reminder notification is sent, its title is exactly "Attendance Not Marked 📢".
When a reminder notification is sent, its body is exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now." (including the curly apostrophe).
If settings.lastReminderDate equals today’s local YYYY-MM-DD string, no reminder is sent again that day.

requirements.text: Implement the reminder notification click behavior so that when the user clicks the reminder notification while the app is running, the app window is focused and the existing "Mark Today’s Classes" bottom sheet opens (without requiring a manual navigation by the user).
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the reminder notification focuses the app window/tab.
After clicking the reminder notification, the app navigates to the Home tab if needed and opens the existing MarkTodaySheet UI (the same UI opened by the Dashboard button).
The click behavior works even if the user is currently on Timetable/Stats/Rank/Settings.
No immutable frontend paths are modified.

requirements.text: Harden the reminder scheduling/polling logic so it is safe and leak-free: only schedule checks when notifications are enabled AND the Streak Reminders category is enabled; ensure intervals are cleaned up on settings changes/unmount; and ensure the reminder check does not spam repeated attempts before 7:00 PM local time.
acceptanceCriteria: If settings.enableNotifications is false or settings.notificationPreferences.streakReminders is false, the reminder hook does not schedule any interval checks.
When the reminder hook is active, it never triggers a notification attempt before 19:00 local time.
Intervals/timeouts created by the reminder hook are cleaned up on unmount and when dependency conditions change, with no accumulating intervals over time.

requirements.text: Add clear English, user-friendly, non-blocking feedback when the app is configured to send reminders but cannot send them due to browser limitations (unsupported Notifications API, permission denied/default, or notifications disabled), using the existing toast/alert patterns and avoiding repeated noisy messages.
acceptanceCriteria: If a reminder attempt fails due to unsupported notifications, permission denied/default, or notifications disabled, the user receives a clear English non-blocking message (toast/alert pattern consistent with the app).
Failure messaging is rate-limited so it is not shown repeatedly in a short period (no spam).
The app never displays raw technical error text to users for reminder-related failures.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing components instead).
Do not edit immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (including frontend/src/main.tsx and the auth hooks).
Keep the architecture single-actor on the backend; no backend changes are required for this reminder logic work.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing true background push notifications or service-worker-based push delivery when the app is closed.
Adding any new backend endpoints or storing reminder state in the backend.
Changing core attendance calculation logic or the mark-today attendance workflow beyond opening the existing UI.
